instruction: Use the pinned Desktop workflow only: Revit 2025, Archicad 27 build 6000 or newer, OpenStudio 3.10.0, and EnergyPlus 25.1.0. For this workflow, the installed entry points are `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe`, `C:\Program Files\GRAPHISOFT\Archicad 27\Archicad.exe`, and `C:\openstudio-3.10.0\bin\openstudio.exe`. Starting from init.ifc and workflow_spec.json, run run_revit_stage.ps1, run_archicad_stage.ps1, and run_openstudio_stage.ps1 in exact order. Do not hand-author delivered IFC, OSM, IDF, SQL, JSON, or CSV. Revit must divide the original 137.28 m2 library annex into geometric LOBBY, READING-ROOM, BOOK-STACK, STAFF-OFFICE and TOILET-SUPPORT spaces, retain the original reading and staff GlobalIds, create a geometric pitched roof, and provide five doors plus three windows with geometric IfcOpeningElement, IfcRelVoidsElement and IfcRelFillsElement relationships. It must export stage1.ifc and revit_handoff.json. Archicad must import stage1.ifc using the supplied IFC4 translator, retain GlobalIds and hosted-opening relationships, validate the public, reading, stack, staff and support energy properties, and export stage2.ifc, archicad_validation_report.json and archicad_handoff.json keyed by actual IfcSpace GlobalIds. OpenStudio must consume stage2.ifc and that handoff, create five separate thermal zones with handed-off schedules, loads and outdoor air, forward-translate result.osm to in.idf, and run a real annual EnergyPlus simulation. Deliver all stage artifacts, native_stage_log.json, workflow.osw, result.osm, in.idf, flow_report.json, model_summary.csv, energy_report.csv, run\eplusout.sql, and run\eplusout.err. Preserve EW3B07, GEOMETRIC-FILLINGS and workflow_spec.json tokens. Evaluation parses IFC entities, space geometry, quantities, properties, GlobalIds, roof geometry and each door/window host-opening relation, reconciles Archicad counts and handoff values, opens standard EnergyPlus SQLite tables, checks zone areas and nonzero simulated energy, and independently reruns EnergyPlus; hashes, tokens, or self-reported JSON alone do not pass.
